name: Goi kho bo
summary: Gỏi khô bò is a dried-beef salad, at Con Market’s outdoor counters in Da Nang, beside ram cuốn cải, hủ tiếu, bánh canh, and hột vịt lộn.
howToEat: Order it at the outdoor counters.
where: Con Market’s outdoor counters, from about 15:00.
seoTitle: Goi kho bo — dried beef salad at Con Market
seoDescription: Gỏi khô bò is a dried-beef salad at Con Market’s outdoor counters in Da Nang, from mid-afternoon.
